title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2608.23035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. Yet existing benchmarks fall into two camps, each with a critical blind spot: GUI-centric benchmarks test surface-level screen manipulation while overlooking background tool use and long-horizon planning, whereas static function-calling benchmarks rely on offline API matching that is detached from real runtime constraints. To close this gap, we present \textbf{MobilePA-Bench}, an interactive, stateful, and tool-centric benchmark for evaluating the tool-calling and planning abilities of mobile planning agents. MobilePA-Bench runs on an executable sandbox that maintains live application databases and returns structured feedback, spanning $13$ functional domains and $212$ realistic mobile tools. translated_title: 移动规划代理基准测试：面向复杂现实任务的移动规划代理评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23035v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着设备端大语言模型代理演变为个人助手，移动操作系统已成为该范式的关键测试平台，使得严格的能力评估变得至关重要。然而，现有基准测试分为两类，每类都存在关键盲点：以图形用户界面为中心的基准测试仅测试表面屏幕操作，却忽视了后台工具使用和长期规划；而静态函数调用基准测试则依赖离线API匹配，与实际运行时约束脱节。为填补这一空白，我们提出了移动规划代理基准测试（MobilePA-Bench），这是一个交互式、有状态且以工具为中心的基准测试，用于评估移动规划代理的工具调用和规划能力。MobilePA-Bench运行在一个可执行的沙盒环境中，该环境维护实时应用程序数据库并返回结构化反馈，涵盖13个功能领域和212个现实移动工具。除基础工具使用外，它还从三个方面评估中央规划代理：复杂任务规划、动态状态管理和多工具协作。
tldr: 本文提出MobilePA-Bench，一个交互式、有状态且以工具为中心的基准测试，用于评估移动规划代理在复杂现实任务中的工具调用和规划能力，填补了现有基准测试在后台工具使用和长期规划方面的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MobilePA-Bench, an interactive, stateful, and tool-centric benchmark for evaluating mobile planning agents' tool-calling and planning abilities on complex real-world tasks, filling the gap in existing benchmarks regarding background tool use and long-horizon planning.
